declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. Case 3 (Cr No 1/2012, Tadepalligudem Town PS) includes IPC 506(2) (criminal intimidation with threat of death/grievous hurt), which carries a maximum of 7 years and qualifies as serious. The other pending cases (IPC 342/427/506/109/149; IPC 353; and Sections 3-4 of the AP Gaming Act) involve sections capped at 2 years or less. All four show 'Charges Framed: No' and zero convictions.
